source: Wikipedia — Opinion polling for the next United Kingdom general election
notes: Figures transcribed from the public Wikipedia table; not affiliated with any pollster.
Restore Britain (rb) is null when the pollster did not break it out.
National VI must not flip seat endorsements alone.

rolling_average.method: Arithmetic mean of latest 7 GB polls with numeric Lab/Con/Ref (window target 7). Restore Britain (rb) averaged only over polls that break it out (need ≥3 in window; else null). Not a MRP; national VI only.
